objective: The three lions (Lion, Sun Lion and a new legendary Shadow Lion, twist speed) rebuilt from scratch as faceted low-poly cats after the Sun Lion reference card from SHANNON (decision 0050), with a presentation render of each. Concept only: nothing is uploaded or wired into the game until SHANNON approves.
acceptance_criteria: The three lions read as one family in the style of the reference: faceted bodies, a mane of crystal shards, paws with toes, slit eyes
Each builds, bakes and exports through the normal build with the usual rig pieces and joints
The other animals build as before
StationConfig, StationAssets and the manifest are untouched until SHANNON approves and the models are uploaded
verification: Blender 5.2 on 2026-11-15, after the simplifying pass, the compact paws and the longer body SHANNON asked for: full build (bake and export) of creature_lion (1200 tris, 7.4 tall x 12.6 long), creature_lion_sun (1296, 9.3 x 15.9) and creature_lion_shadow (1272, 8.4 x 14.5) passed, with body, head, four legs and tail pieces and the glow pieces; the presentation cards were compared with the reference. The manifest was restored after the test builds, so the game is unchanged. Lune 687/687. Not done: the upload, the StationConfig variant, the new shapes under the walk and attack clips in the game.
notes: Checkpoint for SHANNON: approve the faceted lions and the Shadow Lion, then the next step is the build for upload, the Upload Blender assets workflow and the StationConfig variant. Open: whether the other animals follow the style; an aura effect in the game for the Sun Lion; a look at the clips on the new legs.
